Currently, spacecraft navigating in the Solar System rely on explicit, pre-planned setup of point-to-point communication links for their navigation. Such approach, does not scale well with the large number of missions planned in the future. Such a system would combine existing (i.e., GNSS) or planned (i.e., Moonlight, MARCONI) systems and would complement this with dedicated SSI nodes.
